description.en: Plugins maintained by c3115644151 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: c3115644151 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护的插件。

description.en: Lets the agent keep watch over your repository the way a maintainer would: it reads the GitHub repositories a session subscribes to, keeps only the events that concern you — failed checks, reviews waiting for you, issues assigned to you, comments that mention you — and injects them at the next turn boundary, so a broken check gets fixed and a review request gets reviewed without waiting for you. A chip in the status row lists them and switches delivery, message clearing and subscriptions. Read-only, no turn on its own, no request while idle.
description.zh: 让 agent 像维护者一样盯着你的仓库：按会话订阅的 GitHub 仓库取数，只保留与你有关、需要你处理的事件（失败的 CI、待你评审的 PR、指派给你的 issue、@你的评论），在回合边界注入会话上下文——CI 挂了就修，有人请你评审就审，不用等你回来看。状态行里的胶囊可查看待处理项，并切换提醒方式、消息清理与订阅仓库。只读 GitHub，默认不主动开启对话，空闲时不发请求。
